t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Different colour gnomes give different colour baskets. You can get an idea of which basket is going to give the most mushrooms when the number of mushrooms a particular basket produces starts to drop.

vb_textbox.text: There are two colours of baskets in the game. Red, brown, pink and purple gnomes take you to a red basket, whereas green, blue, orange and yellow gnomes take you to the yellow basket. The points you earn is trial and error at first, but the gnomes will either be assigned to a 0-4 point bracket or 5-9 point bracket. You can tell which will score higher when the number of the mushrooms for that colour basket start to increase as you progress through the game. When the number of mushrooms being produced from the basket starts to drop, you know that you need to switch to a gnome that will take you to the opposing basket. Points can fluctuate between the two baskets so you need to make sure to keep switching between baskets depending on the number of mushrooms it is producing.
